### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Bug is fixed and reproduced by a regression test as far to the left as possible (`unit` > `integration` > `e2e`).
- [ ] Quality gates pass (`npm run lint`, `npm run type-check`, `npm run format:check`).
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior/contracts changed.
- [ ] `BACKLOG.md` pruned in resolving PR (if tracked).
